terms.title: Delivery of 100 widgets to Depot B
terms.claim: The supplier delivered 100 widgets to Depot B on 2026-10-10

criteria.text: 100 widgets were delivered to Depot B on 2026-10-10

bound.findings: a majority of validators, each running the assessment itself, reproduced for each criterion whether it is supported, and so whether the claim is
leader_recorded: the finer label of a criterion that is not supported, and so of the overall finding

missing: A delivery receipt, signed proof of receipt, shipping record, or clear photo/document showing 100 widgets reached Depot B on 2026-10-10
criteria.rationale: E-0001 shows a document page with the text "ORDER OF THE MOST EXCELLENT ORDER" and a date of September 14, 2020. It does not show widgets, Depot B, a recipient, a delivery event, or the date 2026-10-10. Because the only filed item is unrelated on its face to the alleged delivery, the evidence is too thin to determine whether 100 widgets were delivered to Depot B on 2026-10-10.
criteria.text: 100 widgets were delivered to Depot B on 2026-10-10

limitations: The assessment could only examine the single filed image and its legible text; it could not verify any unfiled shipping, receipt, or inventory records.
A photograph or document page shows only what is visible on it and does not by itself establish when a delivery occurred unless that is shown in the evidence.

observations.shows: The image shows a page with a heading near the top left and a large grid of small square box icons below. It appears to be a document or form page rather than a photograph of delivered goods or a location. No visible damage or handling is apparent, and there is no visible sign of delivery activity.
observations.subject_doubts: The image appears to show a document page with repeated box graphics, not goods, documents being handed over, or a delivery scene.
text: ORDER OF THE MOST EXCELLENT ORDER

decision.scope: Whether the filed evidence establishes each criterion the parties accepted before the evidence was filed. Not a legal finding, not a finding about who is telling the truth, and not proof of when a photograph was taken or that a file is authentic.
